<!-- pr-reviewer: 46d012c7dbca0e2341d8350ba97c6dbdabd6951d -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (two non-blocking notes below).

**What looks good**
- `hole_digest::put` snaps with `cl::lattice` (`crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs:67`, `round(v*1e6)/1e6`), the same function `HoleDto::from_hole` and `CrossHoleDto::from_hole` call at save (`crates/app/src/project/params.rs:1287-1290, 1329-1336`). It only merges values the file would also merge, so a stale path cannot read fresh. Inch documents hold mm in memory, so no unit handling is needed.
- The radial `dir` is hashed verbatim and `CrossHoleDto` stores it verbatim (`params.rs:1333`), so there is no opposite drift (Ok before save, Stale after reopen).
- The Drill (holes and cross), Bore and Thread arms all go through the one digest. Byte order per hole is unchanged and on-lattice holes hash as before.
- Sweep claim holds. In `project/`, `lattice(` appears only in the hole/cross DTOs and in cached-output DTOs (moves, comp spans, drill cycles, thread cycles, edge breaks, touches), which are not stamp inputs.
- 400-line limit holds (`hole_digest.rs` is 76 lines, `params.rs` shrinks), provenance line present, decision file present, `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1560` present, no `PROCESS_VERSION` or process-file change, no snapshot or golden change.

**Local results (PR head merged with upstream/main - already up to date; macOS, sccache)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 238 passed |
| bore_core / bore_entry | 5 / 4 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| face_holes | 3 passed |
| operations / mcp / commands_undo | 119 (6 ignored) / 22 / 30 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation checks (each run against lib, bore_core, bore_entry, face_holes, project_roundtrip)**
| Mutant | Result |
|---|---|
| no rounding in `put` | red (unit pin + MCP pin) |
| lattice 1e-2 mm (10 um) | red (unit pin) |
| lattice 1e-3 mm | green (survives; the unit pin's 3.81 vs 3.811 step is exactly one lattice step) |
| drop cross `dir` | green |
| drop cross `radius/entry_d/floor_d` | green (also green in operations, mcp, commands_undo) |
| cross `origin.z` unrounded | green |

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The radial (cross-hole) half of `hole_digest::cross` has no pin of its own. A stamp change there, or a mutant dropping a field, passes every suite I ran. The code reads correct, and this gap was there before the PR. A small unit test next to `a_typed_floor_stamps_like_the_one_the_file_reloads` is worth adding as a follow-up: an off-lattice `origin`/`floor_d` digests like its snapped form, and a 1e-3 change in `dir`, `radius` or `floor_d` moves the digest.
2. `lattice` is `1e-6` mm (a nanometre), although the PR text and module comments call it "1 um". The mm-scale pins still separate it from a 10 um snap; a "+2 um edit goes Stale" case is covered by the 3.81 vs 3.811 step. Consider wording the comments as 1e-6 mm.
3. As the PR says, a file saved before this fix with an off-lattice stamp reads Stale once and a regenerate fixes it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 46d012c7dbca0e2341d8350ba97c6dbdabd6951d -->
**Verdict: no blocker found by reading; the build is not proven green (runner clippy step red on code this PR does not touch). Needs a maintainer look.**

**What looks good**
- `hole_digest` snaps with `cl::lattice` (1e-6), the same snap `HoleDto` / `CrossHoleDto` apply at save, so it only merges values the file would also merge. Holes 0.5 um or more apart still hash apart; non-finite values pass through, no unwrap/expect/panic. The radial `dir` stays verbatim, as the file stores it.
- On-lattice holes keep their old bytes (relies on `lattice` being idempotent in f64); a file stamped before the fix from an off-lattice hole reads Stale once, which the PR body states.
- Diff touches only `operation/{hole_digest,mod,params}.rs`, `bore_core.rs`, `bore_entry.rs` and the decision file: no Cargo/build.rs/.github/scripts/xtask, no format bump, no golden or snapshot change. Decision file present.

**Results (self-hosted runner, trial merge with main): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43551176110**
- Quick gate: green, "wall 12.4 min, 2 step(s), 0 failed" (app lib + the gate-mapped app suites incl. bore_core, bore_entry, project_roundtrip, float_roundtrip, face_holes; ui suites).
- Clippy on the touched crates: FAILED, only in `camcraft-geometry`: `needless_range_loop` ("the loop variable `slot` is only used to index `e.facets`") at `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs` 481, 1205, 1486 (runner clippy 1.100). That is issue 1624. The PR does not touch `crates/geometry`. Because the geometry build stopped, clippy never reached `camcraft-app`, so the new code is not clippy-checked by the runner (the author reports clippy clean on app).
- Not run here: Windows, batch and release tiers, GUI hole table.

**Requested before merge**
- None from the diff.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- A maintainer should decide whether to accept the red clippy step as the known 1624 runner issue, or run `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` once, since the runner could not.
- This head already has a collaborator review (mkinney) reading ready; this independent build adds the runner result above.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 46d012c7dbca0e2341d8350ba97c6dbdabd6951d -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**.

BUILD: green on the self-hosted macOS runner, trial merge with main 58e379a65: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43560602567 - every step success; quick gate "wall 12.4 min, 2 step(s), 0 failed" (app suites ok, ui suites ok); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. Not run: Windows, batch and release tiers.

**What looks good**
- `crates/app/src/operation/hole_digest.rs:22-24` snaps every hole float with `cl::lattice`, the same snap `HoleDto` / `CrossHoleDto` apply at save, so the stamp merges only values the file would also merge: a stale path cannot read fresh. Holes 0.5 um or more apart still hash apart (unit pin at :72-74). Non-finite values pass through; no unwrap/expect/panic.
- Radial `dir` hashed verbatim (:46-48), as the file stores it; no opposite drift.
- Drill (holes + cross), Bore and Thread arms (`params.rs` ~1074, 1083, 1407, 1633) all use the one digest; byte order unchanged, on-lattice holes hash as before.
- Pins through the commands and MCP (bore_entry, bore_core) cover save and reopen; decision file, provenance line, Changelog and Fixes present; no Cargo/build.rs/.github/scripts/xtask, format, golden or snapshot change; files under 400 lines.

**Results**
- Earlier runner run 43551176110: quick gate green (0 failed); clippy red only in camcraft-geometry (issue 1624, fixed on main by PR 1629), so app clippy never ran.
- New run 43560602567 at this head, trial-merged with main 58e379a65 on the macOS runner: success, clippy on camcraft-app clean.

**Requested before merge**
- None from the diff.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The radial half (`hole_digest::cross`) has no unit pin of its own (mkinney's mutation check: dropping fields survives). Follow-up test suggested.
2. `lattice` is 1e-6 mm, while comments and PR text say "1 um".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
